device.description: 16-bit 1-channel buffered voltage-output DAC with external reference, 24-bit SPI write-only interface and RSTSEL zero/midscale reset
device.note: dac82001.pdf (SBASAK3A) p.3 pinout (Table 5-1), p.4 recommended operating conditions (VDD 2.7-5.5 V, VIH 1.62 V), p.6 timing (6.6, Figure 6-1), p.12-13 DAC register structure, POR, hardware and software reset, p.14 SPI frame (Table 7-1) and SYNC interrupt, p.15-16 register map (Tables 7-2 to 7-6)

registers.name: SYNC
registers.note: p.15 Table 7-4: DAC-SYNC-EN 1 = update on the software LDAC trigger, 0 = update at SYNC rising (default)

registers.name: TRIGGER
registers.note: p.16 Table 7-5: LDAC and SOFT-RESET (1010) self-resetting trigger bits (protocol.triggers)

registers.name: DAC
registers.note: p.16 Table 7-6: DAC-DATA[15:0] MSB aligned straight binary; reset 0000h (RSTSEL low) or 8000h (RSTSEL high); the DAC buffer register

registers.name: DAC_ACT
registers.note: internal: the DAC active register (drives VOUT); p.12: asynchronous mode updates it at SYNC rising

commands.name: Write DAC
commands.note: p.12: asynchronous mode (DAC-SYNC-EN = 0) updates the active register at SYNC rising

commands.name: Write DAC (synchronous)
commands.note: p.12: synchronous mode waits for the TRIGGER LDAC bit

commands.name: Write
commands.note: p.14 Table 7-1: bit 23 W, bits 22-16 register address, bits 15-0 data; registers update at SYNC rising; SYNC high before the 24th SCLK falling edge discards the frame

pages: p.3 (pinout), p.4 (ROC), p.6 (timing), p.12-13 (register structure, POR, resets), p.14 (SPI frame, SYNC interrupt), p.15-16 (registers)
notModeled: bit 23 (W) of the frame: the datasheet gives no value for it; the model ignores it
write-only interface (no SDO): registers cannot be read back
LDAC and SOFT-RESET bits self-reset: the model keeps the written value in TRIGGER (a later write of 1 still triggers)
the 250-us POR / RESET delay and the 1-us DAC update wait
